limitations: The drill successor and rollback target share deployment-critical source configuration and lock identity; this proves source-bound deployment recovery, stable resource identity and hosted postconditions, not restoration from an intentionally broken content build.
Two opt-in probes observed one isolate and one module-scoped ManagedRuntime construction; this does not claim global isolate identity.
nonClaims: This normal rollback receipt does not prove break-glass provider-version rollback, custom-domain, DNS, release, publication or future rollback behavior.
Screenshots supplement and do not replace provider, state, HTTP, browser, accessibility, console or cache-header proof.
